title: Premium Billing Terms — Rental Property Service Contracts
content:
These terms govern how premium is billed on a Rental Property Service Contracts contract.

**Term A — base monthly amount.** The base monthly amount is the tier's monthly premium plus the tier's additional-unit monthly premium for each unit beyond the first.

**Term B (retired) — no longer in force as an unqualified clause:** "A monthly-billed contract is charged one monthly installment per billing period, equal to the base monthly amount reduced by the term's portfolio discount rate under the portfolio discount terms and rounded to the cent." This clause is superseded by the current basis: for an installment that fell due and was never billed, the installment is fixed by the late-billed installment basis, and only for such an installment; every installment billed on its due date is still charged as this clause states.

**Term C — billing periods.** Billing periods start on the same calendar day of the month as the term start date (the last day of the month when that day does not exist), and each installment is due on its period start.

**Term D (retired) — no longer in force as an unqualified clause:** "An annual-billed contract is charged one annual premium per term on the term start date, equal to twelve base monthly amounts reduced first by the pay-in-full discount rate and then by the portfolio discount rate, rounded to the cent once at the end; the two discounts multiply and are never added." This clause is superseded by the current basis: for the premium of a late renewal, the late-renewal premium basis applies in place of these annual premium terms, and only for such a premium; every other annual premium is still charged as this clause states.

**Term E.** Each premium charge records the portfolio discount rate applied.

**Term F (retired) — no longer in force as an unqualified clause:** "A returned payment is billed back as a returned payment charge plus one returned-payment fee charge of the tier's returned-payment fee." This clause is superseded by the current basis: for a returned-payment fee, the fee is set by the returned-payment fee basis, and only for such a fee; the returned payment itself is still billed back in full as a returned payment charge.

**Term G.** A transfer is billed one transfer fee charge of the tier's transfer fee to the purchaser.

**Term H (retired) — no longer in force as an unqualified clause:** "Premium is billed only while the contract status is waiting period, active or suspended for nonpayment." This clause is superseded by the current basis: for a catch-up charge for a tier upgrade made during a term that has since ended, the charge is billed on the contract whatever status the contract now shows, and only for such a catch-up charge; every other premium charge remains billed only while the contract is open, in status waiting period, active or suspended for nonpayment. The status is read from the system record of the contract being billed, before the charge.

## Statuses under which premium is billed (every charge other than a catch-up charge)

| Contract status | Premium billed |
|---|---|
| Waiting period | yes |
| Active | yes |
| Suspended for nonpayment | yes |
| Expired | no |
| Cancelled | no |

## Worked figures under Terms A, B and D (hypothetical contracts billed on their due dates)

- Bridgewell Rental Combo, one unit, portfolio rate 0.05, billed monthly: $64.99 reduced by 0.05 is $61.7405, rounded to **$61.74** per installment.
- The same contract billed annually: twelve times $64.99 is $779.88; reduced by the pay-in-full rate of 0.10 it is $701.892; reduced by 0.05 it is $666.7974; rounded once, **$666.80**.
- Bridgewell Rental Multi-Unit Combo, three units, no portfolio discount, billed monthly: $69.99 plus two times $39.99 is **$149.97** per installment.
